name: Original 40 Brewing Company
notes: Own site (original40brewing.com) links to /menu/, /menus/ and /drink-menu/, none of which render food prices in raw HTML directly, but /menus/ links to the restaurant's Toast marketing page which named the Toast slug (the-original-40-brewery); read the full priced food menu from Toast's __OO_STATE__ Apollo cache (parsed by balancing braces from the opening {, not by matching to a closing script tag). Two Menu objects exist in the cache - 'Gift Cards' (empty) and 'Online Ordering' (one Food group, 12 items) - confirmed not a duplicate-menu case, only one real menu. The site's own /drink-menu/ page embeds a beer/cider/seltzer/wine/cocktail list as an image (OG40-BeerList image, dated visually current with a Sept-2025 upload path); read the image directly and confirmed by inspection that it lists every beer, wine, seltzer and cocktail by name and ABV/style only - genuinely no dollar price printed anywhere on the board, for any of the roughly 30 drink items. This is a real published gap, not a capture failure: the Toast online-ordering catalog also has no beer/drink group at all (only Food), consistent with a taproom that does not price its tap list for to-go ordering. Drink section is excluded entirely rather than guessed; only the 12 priced Toast food items are recorded.
